source:
@@U03357@@
Who knows, maybe Paradise was like this.
We're just glad to be here, and
thank our lucky stars for it. East or west,
Mother Earth is forever fruitful.

@@U03359@@
If Earth Mother in a single night
Could bring these little ones to light,
Then She the littlest can create,
And each of us will find a mate.

@@U03361@@
Hurry! Make haste!
See you're properly placed!
With speed as our muscle,
Let’s hustle and bustle!
While peace still holds steady
Make our foundries ready,
Weapons with speed
The army will need.
Ants, gather near,
We ask of you here
Bring metal, bring ore!
And dactyls so many
You smallest of any,
Do us all good,
Fetch us much wood!
Pile it up high,
High as the sky,
Of coals we need more!

@@U03363@@
With arrow and bow
March out to the foe!
Shoot me those herons
Down there by the marsh,
Clustering numberless,
Croaking so harsh,
Puffing and preening,
translation:
@@U03357@@
谁知道呢，也许天堂就是这样的。
我们很高兴来到这里，并且
感谢我们的幸运星。东或西，
地球母亲永远硕果累累。

@@U03359@@
如果地球母亲在一夜之间
可以让这些小孩子曝光，
然后她最小的就能创造，
我们每个人都会找到一个伴侣。

@@U03361@@
快点！赶快！
看看你的位置是否正确！
以速度为我们的肌肉，
让我们热闹起来吧！
虽然和平依然稳定
让我们的铸造厂做好准备，
具有速度的武器
军队需要。
蚂蚁，聚集过来，
我们在这里向您请教
带金属，带矿石！
还有这么多的短指
你是所有人中最小的，
愿我们大家都好，
给我们拿很多木头来！
堆得高高的，
高如天，
我们需要更多的煤炭！

@@U03363@@
带着箭和弓
向敌人进军！
向我射那些苍鹭
在那儿的沼泽地旁边，
聚集无数，
叫声如此刺耳，
吹气和整理，
